crossRefs.note: Elisha sent a messenger to him, saying, “Go and wash in the Jordan seven times, and your flesh shall come again to you…
His mother said to the servants, “Whatever he says to you, do it.”
Jesus said, “Take away the stone.” Martha, the sister of him who was dead, said to him, “Lord, by this time there is a…
Yahweh said to him, “What is that in your hand?” He said, “A rod.”
You shall take this rod in your hand, with which you shall do the signs.”
That same night, Yahweh said to him, “Arise, go down into the camp, for I have delivered it into your hand.
When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then stir yourself up; for then Yahweh has gone…
For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.
The word of Samuel came to all Israel. Now Israel went out against the Philistines to battle, and encamped beside…
At the return of the year, Ben Hadad mustered the Syrians, and went up to Aphek, to fight against Israel.

people.name: Aphek
people.line: A city in the north, site of Aramean battles.

people.name: Syria
people.line: Ancient region north of Israel, often in conflict

translations.web: He said, “Open the window eastward;” and he opened it. Then Elisha said, “Shoot!” and he shot. He said, “Yahweh’s arrow of victory, even the arrow of victory over Syria; for you will strike the Syrians in Aphek, until you have consumed them.”
translations.bsb: “Open the east window,” said Elisha. So he opened it and Elisha said, “Shoot!” So he shot. And Elisha declared: “This is the LORD’s arrow of victory, the arrow of victory over Aram, for you shall strike the Arameans in Aphek until you have put an end to them.”
translations.kjv: And he said, Open the window eastward. And he opened it. Then Elisha said, Shoot. And he shot. And he said, The arrow of the LORD'S deliverance, and the arrow of deliverance from Syria: for thou shalt smite the Syrians in Aphek, till thou have consumed them.
translations.asv: And he said, Open the window eastward; and he opened it. Then Elisha said, Shoot; and he shot. And he said, Jehovah's arrow of victory, even the arrow of victory over Syria; for thou shalt smite the Syrians in Aphek, till thou have consumed them.
